Hello Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

I've got your brief: I manage your calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 only, nothing outside those hours) and your messages, and I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date with a log of every booking, decline and deletion.

What I can do for you:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** (plus Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there — each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set that up?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule things, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk.

I've read next week's calendar. What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Glad to meet you.

Briefly:
- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, root CA at /v1/pki/ca): from any phone or computer on the same network — take the certificate on the first visit and you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Messengers**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own separate account with its own phone number, not yours — you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Accounts elsewhere**: I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- Also: scheduling, shell commands, languages, voice.

I've also read the setup for Professor Alvarez: I manage next week's calendar in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing outside them), and I can write to contacts on the web channel — so far Sarah (sarah-agent). Each student who asks gets a 30-minute 1:1 next week; I'll book it, log it, and keep the file up to date.

What would you like to start with?

On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez proposing 30 minutes next week. I checked your schedule for Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27: Wednesday and Thursday are full, so the open half-hours are Monday 10:00–10:30, Monday 14:00–14:30, Tuesday 11:00–11:30, Tuesday 15:00–15:30 and Friday 11:00–11:30. I'll book it and log it in CALENDAR.md as soon as he confirms.
Understood — I'll handle the 1:1 myself and won't need you for it. Confirmation and the CALENDAR.md log entry will be waiting for you.
Done — your 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is booked for **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**. It's in CALENDAR.md under Monday and logged as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Alvarez`. Enjoy your week away.
